meta.title: Weather and Clothes
meta.textType: a geography text with key words

paragraphs: Weather and Clothes, posted by Lily. This week, our geography lesson was about weather and clothes. Teacher Kim asked, "What is in your wardrobe, and why?" A wardrobe is a big cupboard for clothes. Your wardrobe tells a story about the weather where you live. I wrote notes in my notebook, and I drew a small map of the world. Geography is on the exam next week, so we were glad to have a clear lesson.

Thailand has three seasons, and they are the hot season, the rainy season, and the cool season. In the hot season, the weather is dry and very hot. The sun is strong at noon, so many people stay in the shade. Pupils wear light shirts and a hat. In the rainy season, it rains almost every day. The air is wet, and sometimes the roads are full of water. People need a raincoat or an umbrella. In the cool season, the mornings are a little cold. Some children wear a thin coat at that time.

In some places in the world, winter is very cold, and there is snow. People there wear a heavy coat, a scarf, and warm boots. Mia asked, "Do you want to see snow?" "Yes, for one day," I said. In a desert, the days are hot, but the nights can be cold. So a pupil in a desert needs light clothes for the day and warm clothes for the night. Our pen pal Nadia lives in Singapore, where the weather is hot and wet all year. She wrote, "We wear light clothes every day, and we always carry an umbrella."

On Saturday, Mia and I went to the market near our school. We saw a small shop, and it had many colors. The shop had a sign in the window. It said, "Special offer: a discount on every raincoat." The rainy season starts soon, so many people wanted one. The raincoats were half price. I did not need a new raincoat, but I was glad to see the price.

Teacher Kim said, "The exam has a question about weather and clothes." We must write about one place and its weather. I will also write that we need a hat for the sun. Here is my answer. In my wardrobe, there are light shirts, shorts, and one raincoat. These clothes are good for the weather in my town. What is in your wardrobe?
